$comment: A second example for the kit: a family birthday with no shuttle and no partner sites. Every person, place and code here is fictional.
title: Ruth turns 80
scheduleLede: Lunch, cake and a walk by the river. Come for all of it or just the cake.
demoNote: Demo party: the people and codes are made up. Try invitation RB-1102 with the last name Moss.

events.name: Birthday lunch
events.details: A sit-down lunch. Ruth asks for no gifts: bring a story instead.

events.name: River walk
events.place: The towpath behind the Mill House
events.details: An easy, flat mile. Bring boots if it has rained.

faq.question: Where do I park?
faq.answer: The Mill House has a free car park with 30 spaces.

faq.question: Should I bring a gift?
faq.answer: No gifts, please. Ruth would love a story or a photo instead.

sampleQueries: What time is lunch, and where do I park?
RSVP for invitation RB-1102, Moss: we're both coming, roast chicken for Dina and the tart for Leo.
Can you order flowers for Ruth?
